title: The reduction's vectors order by order, on the cut-open torus at powers of two
claim: At n = 2^m, h = n/2, q = 2n, for a in GF(q)* with G the monic least-degree element of ker X_b, k = h - deg G, J = ceil(k/2), N = G(k) G(k + 1), W(A, B) = A(k) B(k + 1) + B(k) A(k + 1) and the family Zhat of CHAIN-ORDERS-20261110-001A: (1) G Z_0 F = (k + 1) W(G, F) mod k^h for every F, and G(1) = b G(0); (2) a Jordan chain of Zhat satisfies W(G, phi_r) = G tau phi_(r-1) + (G/(k + 1)) sum_(s>=2) Zhat_s phi_(r-s) mod k^h; (3) for x = G Y^i with 2i < k - 1 and phi_1 = k x, every second chain vector has W(G, phi_2) = [N Y^i (1 + L(Y)) + a^2 G(0)^2 [i = 0] Y^(h-1)] mod Y^h, of degree below h - J, L(Y) = Y + Y^2 + ... + Y^(h/2); (4) if G(0) != 0 there is G' of degree exactly h + k - 1 - 2J with Z_0 G' = 0 mod k^(h-J-1) and W(G, G') = c Y^(h-J-1), c != 0; (5) c Y^(h-J-1) F = W(G', F) G + W(G, F) G' for every F. Computed: G(0) != 0 at every a for sides 8 to 128; at co-distance 3 the reduction's coefficient at l^5 is <S psi_2(x), psi_2(y)>, whose pure part <S k^2 x, k^2 y> = 1 is cancelled by the corrections (129 cases, sides 16 to 64). The registered target, the leading form at every order, is not reached: by the frozen stop rule the attempt ends at order 2, psi_2 having a closed form only through the second solution G' and the cancellation at co-distance 3 not being derived.
failure_conditions: An order r and an eigenvalue at which a claimed closed form of psi_r fails, or the reduction's coefficient at l^(2t-1) on co-distance t differs from [t a power of two] (computed false at every a for sides 8 to 256 by CHAIN-ORDERS-20261110-001).
foundation_claim_scope: The square torus of rule-60 rings with equally spaced law-(12, 12) contacts, cut open by a ring of cuts each way (A30, A32, A37, A38); its walk over GF(2), at sides 2^m. The spectrum is a contact-level reading, so it does not depend on how the rings are declared (A45).

validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the coordinator's go-ahead on 2026-11-10 (sub-goals B73 and B91).
validation.status: proof by hand (Theorems 1 to 5) with finite checks; the attempt stopped at order 2 by the frozen rule
validation.novelty: new as far as found (bounded search of 2026-11-09); ingredients classical (Wronskians over F(Y), consecutive Pade solutions, the 2n + 1 rule)
